sections.fullText:
Elderly homes around the country support a large number of senior citizens that are in need of assisted living or a roof over their heads. The population of that belongs to this age group has increased steadily since the 1950s. The Census of India 2001 enumerated approximately 7.6 crore senior citizens in India, which has increased to 10.4 crores in 2011.

With the rising income levels, a growing number of these senior citizens are now economically independent and willing to pay for senior living facilities and services related to their physical, medical and psychological needs. However, an extremely large number of elderly people lack the economic means or support from their families and have no choice but to move to special homes for the senior or shelter homes that can provide them with a comfortable elderly living environment, meals or medical care.

There are numerous foundations on the SevaDeep platform that provide care services to elderly parents who have no home or family. There are approximately 728 old age shelters in India today. 101 of these are reserved for women and 278 old age homes support aged parents with medical needs.

These facilities need everyone’s support to operate. Close to 18 million people above the age of 60 in India are homeless and these old age homes provide them love, respect and dignity in the late stages of their lives.

What can you donate?




1. Old furniture

Old age homes are constantly in need of cupboards, sofa sets, chairs, tables and beds.




2. Blankets, throws or shawls

According to agingcare.com, seniors can become “dangerously chilled because they have less fat, slower circulation, and more sluggish metabolism. A senior can even become hypothermic while indoors.” Receiving a blanket or shawl can warm the body and the heart.




3. Old appliances

Old TV sets, microwaves and refrigerators are crucial appliances for many old age homes.




4. Games, puzzles and books

Nothing keeps the mind active and can provide hours of fun like games and books. If you’d like to give away some of these items, old age homes will be happy to take them.




Log on to the SevaDeep platform and browse through our list of senior citizen homes to view their needs. If you have items to donate, just schedule your donation on the platform and we will take care of the rest. Stay tuned for more news and updates from SevaDeep on our Facebook page .
